changes: Initial implementation of IP TV support. You can now listen to IP TV directly from Luna and it supports most common stream types such as Stalker and Xtream. It also supports opening an M3U lists which are designed for IP TV.

Fixed a bug where listening to low sample-rate files would produce a ring or a beep because the Equalizer was not aware of the sample-rate of the file and wasn't skipping bands which are higher than the file's sample rate.
